text:
Priya: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of tenants with sudden quota spikes in the console around 09:10 UTC. Investigating and it looks like a compact route-id encoding mismatch between SDKs and the routing service.
Alex: Ugh. Do you have an example header/value?
Priya: Yup — example coming from a TS client: `x-redwood-route: cHJlZml4OjEyMzQ=`. The router expects a hex-prefixed ID like `prefx:abcd1234` after decoding but TS/py clients are base64-ing a JSON blob.
Jamie: That explains why console is creating new buckets instead of attributing to existing route keys. Quick question — which SDK versions?
Priya: Affected: python-sdk <= 1.4.2, ts-sdk <= 2.0.0-rc3. Go clients look fine (they send plain ascii).
Leo: Can we sniff decode in the router and fallback to legacy parsing? We should avoid losing live attribution while we ship SDK patches.
Priya: I added a temporary tolerant decode in the routing proxy: try-as-hex -> try-base64-json -> try-legacy. It will coalesce to existing buckets for most traffic. Deployed to canary.
Alex: Nice. Telemetry wise we should tag which path matched so we can remove the fallback later. Add a `route.decode.path` tag with values `hex|base64-json|legacy`.
Priya: Agreed. I also added a `x-route-decode` debug header to responses in canary so SDKs can log. Example: ````
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-route-decode: base64-json->prefx:0123
````
Jamie: For SDK patches: Py and TS can ship a minor that switches to the canonical ascii prefix format. I can cut py 1.4.3 and ts 2.0.1 today. Both will also emit a deprecation warning when they detect old encoding.
Alex: Go teams — can you confirm no downstream change needed?
Leo: Go already uses canonical prefix, just verifying tests. Ok.
Priya: Console/dashboard side — we need a one-time mapping job to merge the accidental buckets created during the window. I can generate an export of (bad_route_id -> decoded_prefx) keys and hand to analytics.
Jamie: Will update changelogs + add migration note in SDK release notes. Also include sample debug snippet: ````
# TS example
const headers = { 'x-redwood-route': Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({prefx: '0123'})).toString('base64') }
````
Alex: Plan for rollout: 1) Keep tolerant decode for 48h; 2) ship py/ts minor patches 3) run mapping job to merge buckets 4) revert tolerant decode. Sound good?
Priya: Yes. Also add telemetry alert for `route.decode.path=base64-json` > 0.5% of traffic post-fix, so we catch stray old clients.
infra-bot: canary deploy succeeded (routing-proxy v3.2.1-canary) — 2/2 healthy hosts, 0 errors. :white_check_mark:
Leo: I'll coordinate with analytics on the merge job and ETA.
Jamie: I'll cut the py/ts releases in the 2pm PT window, add the deprecation note and sample fix.
Priya: Thanks — assigning: Jamie (SDK patches), Leo (mapping + console), Alex (telemetry rule + rollback plan). I'll monitor canary and post updates here. :thumbsup:
